name: 🔊 Brazilian Army
desc:
👋 Welcome to the Brazilian Army

👍 Play the game and join our group

How to play:

🏅 Join the United Brazilian Army or become a criminal and fight against the Army
🆙 Rank up through physical training, missions, events, or operations
🔨 Explore the city, rob, or train in the barracks to earn money
🎓 With each rank, you unlock more resources and tasks
🔥 Try to reach the maximum rank
👥 Make friends or enemies

💻 Compatible with computers, phones, consoles, and tablets
